description: Find markets from Horizontal's Startup Trends: startup markets that are forming, each with its stage (emerging, heating up, overheated or cooling) set by a published rule from eight checks of builders, buyers, proof of money and signs of crowding, a verdict on whether it is worth entering now and how, and its headline figures. Every figure has a source and says who claims it. Analysis, not investment advice.

language.description: The language of the words in the answer.

query.description: What the market should be about, in English or Chinese: "ESP32", "AI glasses", "短剧", "vibe coding". Leave it out for every market.

stage.description: Only markets at this stage: emerging (More people are building or buying, but nobody has shown checkable money yet.); heating (More people are paying, small teams have made money someone checked, and fewer than three signs of crowding show.); overheated (Three or more of the five signs of crowding: hype ahead of sales, a price war, giants moving in, money cooling, high churn.); cooling (Fewer people are paying, and fewer are building or the money is leaving.)

name: search_trends
title: Startup markets that are forming, and their stage
